name: zsho.ot
tagline: Capturing moments that deserve to be shared.
introduction: Photography & visual storytelling by Yeah Jing Ze.
bio: I’m Yeah Jing Ze, a Multimedia Computing student at the University of Malaya with a passion for photography and visual storytelling. I enjoy capturing moments and emotions through event, portrait, street, and creative photography. Through photography, I aim to preserve meaningful experiences while expressing creativity.

experience.description: Edited reels, assisted with shoots, and helped set up scenes for filming.
